# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest released version of `token-trim` receives security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.1   | :x:                |

---

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of `token-trim` seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability or security-related flaw, please **do not open a public GitHub issue**.

Instead, please report vulnerabilities privately using one of the following methods:

1. **GitHub Security Advisory (Recommended):**
   - Go to the **Security** tab of the [`token-trim` repository](https://github.com/pareshrnayak/token-trim/security).
   - Click **Report a vulnerability**.

2. **Direct Contact:**
   - Reach out directly to the maintainer via GitHub.

---

## What to Include in Your Report

To help us triage and resolve the issue quickly, please include:

- A clear description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce the issue (including sample code or inputs, if applicable).
- Potential impact of the vulnerability.
- Any proposed fixes or mitigations.

---

## Our Commitment

- We will acknowledge receipt of your security report within **48 hours**.
- We will keep you updated on the progress towards a fix.
- Once a patch is released, we will credit you in the release notes (unless you prefer to remain anonymous).
